title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Guy. Part 6
body: He asks where you are and calls it care. He wants to know who you were talking to at 1am. He says "I only want to protect you" and the list of things you cannot do keeps growing. Care asks how you are. Control asks where you were. Learn the difference early.
caption:
Tag the friend who says he is different.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Spot Red Flags in a Girl. Part 6
body: Her best friend knows everything first. You learn about your own fight from her friend's story. You apologised privately and it was discussed in a group chat of nine. Her friends get a vote. You get the verdict. Date the group chat or leave the group chat.
caption:
Send this to him. Anonymously.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in a Rishta Meeting. Part 6
body: Then comes the waiting. "We will call you." Three weeks later: "We liked the girl, but my sister's brother in law has a different proposal." You did not fail the interview. You were the backup candidate. Block no one. Eat the biscuits and move on.
caption:
Tag the friend who survived this exact meeting.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Maybe Zone. Part 6
body: You ask "what are we?" and get "let's not rush." It has been eight months. Rushing would be a gift. The maybe zone has no timer and no exit sign. Everyone else can see the exit. You are the only one looking at the wall and calling it a door.
caption:
Tag the one who is stuck in the maybe zone.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags on a First Date. Part 6
body: The waiter brings the wrong order. He says "bhai kya kar rahe ho" like he is the CEO of cutlery. Watch how he treats someone he will never see again. That is how he will treat you in year three. Tip the waiter. Do not tip the date.
caption:
Send this before your next date.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags When He Texts. Part 6
body: He sends reels instead of conversations. Forty a day. He loves you forty reels worth. He never asks how your day was. The relationship runs on a content sharing platform with no feelings and a lot of memes. Send him one back that says "talk to me."
caption:
Tag the friend who is waiting for a reply.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Her Emotional Support Contact. Part 6
body: "You're the only one who understands me." She says this to four people. You are one of four only ones. It is a franchise and you are the branch that never closes. Real friendship goes both ways. She should know your favourite food by now.
caption:
Send this to someone who always listens and never gets asked.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Never Date a Playboy. Part 6
body: He is amazing for two weeks. Flowers, calls, long messages. Then slowly, "I'm so busy." That was the free trial. You were a subscriber for fourteen days. Now he is onto the next demo. Never fall for the first two weeks. Fall for the third month.
caption:
Send this to the friend who says he's changed.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Red Flags in His Instagram. Part 6
body: His comments are always "wow" and the fire emoji under the same four girls. Under yours it is "nice pic." His replies to other girls are poetry. His replies to you are "hmm." Check who gets the paragraphs. Those are the ones he is actually texting.
caption:
Send this to a friend who is stalking his profile.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 The Taxi Light Theory. Part 6
body: The cruel part: his readiness has nothing to do with your effort. Same man, same age, new girl, ring in four months. Did she cook better? No. She arrived when the light was on. Stop auditing yourself. You are not a bad candidate. You were in the wrong timeslot.
caption:
Send this to someone who thinks it was their fault.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 Who Has to Approve Your Marriage. Part 6
body: The family group has forty three members. A proposal goes in: seventeen thumbs up, twelve "hmm," eight "let's wait," four who muted the group, two who posted a poem. The decision: wait. As always. The committee runs on tea, rumours and a very long agenda.
caption:
Send this to the family group chat. We dare you.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Find a Spiritual Partner. Part 6
body: He is a life coach. Of what? Life. Certified by whom? A weekend course. He charges fifteen thousand an hour to tell people to drink water. His bio says Healer, Speaker, Seeker. Seeker of what? Investors. Ask him to heal your Careem bill first.
caption:
Send this to someone who is healing at your expense.

#redflags #dating #rishta #relationships #pakistan #relatable

title: 🚩 How to Read a Rishta Profile. Part 6
body: Age: "looks younger." Photo: from 2014. Height: five eleven, with shoes, on a good day. Income: "good." Health: "perfect." The profile is a cover letter with no references. And the references, if you find them, will say "he is very simple."
caption:
Tag the friend whose biodata needs a rewrite.
